# Film Runtime and IMDb Ratings

This page examines whether film runtime is related to IMDb ratings. As shown in @fig-runtime-rating, the scatter plot compares the length of each film with its IMDb rating.

```{python}
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "Relationship between film runtime and IMDb rating"
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])

plt.xlabel("Runtime (Minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating (0-10)")
plt.title("Film Runtime vs. IMDb Rating")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
```

## Average IMDb Rating by Decade

The following table displays the mean IMDb rating for films released in each decade.

```{python}
#| echo: true

films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10

decade_ratings = (
    films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"]
    .mean()
    .round(2)
)

decade_ratings.to_frame(name="Mean IMDb Rating")
```
